methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: a modular EMS architecture aligned with ISO 50001 energy management standards

stage1.ineligibility_reason: No EnPI/EnB energy-performance measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or critiqued. The paper designs and simulates a renewable energy system (3 MW PV, 2.97 MWh LiFePO4 battery, Python/Django EMS, active harmonic filter) for a single lumber mill; ISO 50001 is cited only as EMS-architecture alignment. The LSTM+Kalman models forecast solar generation and the PV/battery/savings equations are sizing and financial formulas, not an energy baseline normalised against relevant variables or an energy performance indicator.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This section details the engineering methods employed in the design and simulation of the net-zero energy system for Elmsdale Lumber

stage1.notes: Simulation-only design for one site (Elmsdale Lumber); strong tool/software-design character too (Django PV sizing tool, Python EMS) but coded single applied case on site cardinality. Lumber/sawmilling is wood-products manufacturing, not a listed continuous-process sector, so level_3b would be false regardless; moot given ineligibility.
